decision.rationale: The scan data contains a clear coaxial group of four cylinders: a large base cylinder (radius 279.4 mm, z 1.97–23.38 mm), a medium shaft (radius 127.0 mm, z 11.55–98.70 mm), a smaller flange (radius 152.4 mm, z 31.75–118.69 mm), and a small top cylinder (radius 31.75 mm, z 286.32–473.18 mm). These are concentric and form a shaft/flange family. The off-axis patches (e.g., mounting holes) are not required for this repair. The scan's geometry supports this hypothesis, despite failed checks indicating incomplete surface reconstruction.

The tapered body geometry is not modeled.

It does not recover mounting holes, blends or tapered body geometry. A subset of four coaxial cylinders is sufficient; off-axis holes do not invalidate that subset. Choose it only if the scan supports a coaxial shaft/flange family. Otherwise abstain. This action is an approximate hypothesis, not a claim of full reconstruction. Do not invent dimensions.
